## Checklist

- [ ] Tests were written first and cover the change.
- [ ] Anything with a lifecycle or I/O is an explicit state machine with the exhaustive transition test.
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass.
- [ ] If this affects ranking or latency, benchmark numbers are included (before and after).
- [ ] Docs and CHANGELOG.md are updated.
